hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL_CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$TOOL_CMD" | grep -q 'gh pr create' || exit 0; PR_URL=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_response.output // ""' | grep -oE 'https://github\.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/[0-9]+' | head -1); [ -z "$PR_URL" ] && exit 0; ORG=$(echo "$PR_URL" | cut -d/ -f4); REPO=$(echo "$PR_URL" | cut -d/ -f5); NUMBER=$(echo "$PR_URL" | cut -d/ -f7); gh api -X POST "/repos/$ORG/$REPO/pulls/$NUMBER/requested_reviewers" -f 'reviewers[]=copilot-pull-request-reviewer' 2>/dev/null && exit 0; printf '{"systemMessage": "Copilot reviewer auto-request failed — add it manually in GitHub UI."}'
